summary: Complete proof strategy determined for S11 interval bound sorries (lines 3328, 3639). The key insight: play sub-interval forward games via h_r1_univ on [m_M, y] vs [m_N, y'], so order agreement at endpoints (position 0 = m_M/m_N) vs responses (position 2 = p_M/p_N) gives m_M < p_M from m_N < p_N. Degenerate case (y' = Sum.inr gamma_N) handled via gap_char_formula transfer + gap_detection_unique. Detailed proof strategy in handoff document.
